artboards.title: Pick a theme — dark and light

annotations.text:
LIGHT THEME — now genuinely light. No dark cards sitting in the middle of it.

The depth comes from alternating tone instead of inversion: grey app → white slab → soft grey well → white tiles, with a shadow lifting the slab. Dark still inverts, because on black that is what gives it its punch. The only high-contrast element left in light is one solid button.

Left board shows all four accents in both themes.

DOODLES — loose line art sitting behind the top of the page and masked so it fades out before it reaches the list. Spirals, sparkles, a dashed sweep, corner arcs, a hand-drawn bar chart, brackets, a zigzag.

Strokes are currentColor, so it inks itself white on dark and black on light. Dark carries it at 14% and light at 8.5% — white on black reads weaker than black on white, so the same number would not look like the same amount of ink.

Two chips above the artboard: Palette and Theme. Eight combinations, all at full size.

Give me a letter and a default theme — say "C, dark" — and I will take the whole app there.

If the doodles want to be busier, quieter, or a different kind of mark altogether, say so. Still no code.
